title: GEMglPixelTransferi

messages.description: symbolic name of the pixel transfer parameter to be set
value to set the pixel transfer parameter to

arguments.description: symbolic name of the pixel transfer parameter to be set
value to set the pixel transfer parameter to

body: [GEMglPixelTransferi] calls glPixelTransferi() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. GL constants are numbers here: [GLdefine] turns a name like GL_LINES into its value. See glPixelTransfer in the OpenGL reference.
